title: The new HTTP QUERY method explained
summary: This article explains the new HTTP QUERY method, a proposed standard for sending query requests with a message body without the idempotency and caching constraints of GET. It addresses the long-standing limitation where GET requests cannot have a request body, forcing developers to use POST for queries.
problem_solved: Provides a standardized HTTP method for safe, idempotent queries that can include a request body, solving the limitation where GET cannot have a body.
why_valuable: Enables cleaner API design by allowing query operations to have request bodies without violating HTTP semantics, improving consistency between client and server implementations.
